Theorem
[Hamilton--Ivey estimate] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0045, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0046 ↗ thm:chow-ii-time-dependent-system-wmp 1. ch10:10.17\group Ricci-flow applications

For a normalized Ricci flow on a closed three-manifold with $ u (\cdot ,0)\ge -1$, every point with $ u <0$ satisfies \[ R\ge | u | igl(\log | u |+\log (1+t)-3 igr). \]
Proof

\sketch ↗ thm:chow-ii-time-dependent-system-wmp The set of curvature operators satisfying the scalar lower bound $R\ge -3/(1+t)$ and, when $ u \le -1/(1+t)$, the displayed logarithmic bound is closed, convex, and parallel invariant. Along the curvature ODE, the first quantity has derivative at least $ rac23R^2$, while direct differentiation of $R/(- u )-\log (- u )-\log (1+t)$ gives a nonnegative derivative whenever $ u \le -1/(1+t)$. Proposition 10.16 therefore preserves the set, proving the estimate.

□
